offNotes.NJ: the vote against Lincoln went to a fusion ticket, so Douglas’s figure there is the whole anti-Lincoln vote
offNotes.NY: the vote against Lincoln went to a fusion ticket, so Douglas’s figure there is the whole anti-Lincoln vote
offNotes.PA: most of the vote against Lincoln went to a fusion ticket, not to Douglas

offNotes.LA: the Republicans shared their elector slate with the Populists, so Harrison’s figure includes Weaver’s vote

offNotes.CA: Taft was not on the ballot, so his votes were write-ins

ev.note: One Washington elector pledged to Gerald Ford voted for Ronald Reagan.
One West Virginia elector pledged to Michael Dukakis voted for Lloyd Bentsen.
One District of Columbia elector pledged to Al Gore cast a blank ballot.
One Minnesota elector pledged to John Kerry voted for John Edwards.
Seven electors voted for someone other than their pledged candidate: five pledged to Hillary Clinton and two pledged to Donald Trump.
